_about: Build 09.3 audio routing. Swap sources or levels here without code changes. Source files are never edited; all shaping (gain, start offset, loop points, voice limits) happens at playback. Measurements: docs/handover/AUDIO_INTEGRATION_093.md.

coil._why: The Runway coil swells for 330 ms before its peak. Skipping the first 0.12 s and layering the short fallback crack keeps the shot instant.

nail._why: The file is itself a 0.6 s burst of rivets; the gun fires every 0.09 s. It plays as a bed retriggered every 0.5 s while firing, faded on release, with the short fallback tick on each shot.

choir._why: A sustained 1 s tone; each shot cuts the previous one so refires every 0.44 s never stack.

combat._why: 145 BPM, first downbeat at 0.030 s. Bar 1 (a quieter intro) plays once; bars 2-18 loop on bar lines with a 60 ms crossfade, because the file ends mid-phrase at full level.
